description:
Decided with Matt on 2026-10-14 in the project thread: the reporter wrapper (integrations/claude-code: report.py, sidecar.py) is dropped. The telemetry step (integrations/claude-code-otlp) is the only way usage reaches Agbredo. We give up the per-agent-run exit code/outcome, the explicit finished+duration per agent run, and usage from killed jobs; run status still comes from GitHub webhooks and polls.

Known callers: the only deployed pipeline (xpmatteo/rpg-interpreter .github/workflows/agent-instructions-audit.yml) uses claude-code-otlp only; .github/workflows/agbredo-example.yml uses claude-code-otlp only.

Work: remove integrations/claude-code and examples/hello-agent (a minimal reporter); update README, docs/10-design.md (Parts, Flow, Trust, Data), docs/20-routes.md, docs/00-glossary.md (Reporter row; Observation = telemetry, webhooks, polls). Old runs whose events embed a report (Event.Claude) must still load and display.

Open question for Matt: what happens to POST /api/agents/{id}/observations and core.Report (keep accepting, or remove the route)?

Check: go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...; python tests for integrations/claude-code-otlp still pass.

comments.text: 2026-10-14, Matt: remove the report route POST /api/agents/{id}/observations and its supporting code and tables. Scope found: integrations/claude-code, examples/hello-agent, webapi report handler, Service.Report, core.Report + validation + tests, docs. lockRun / reportRunID / verifyReport are shared with telemetry: move them unchanged (keep the 'observe:' ID prefix so run IDs stay stable). No table is report-only: events also holds GitHub status changes (type github.workflow_run). Still open for Matt: delete old report rows (events type claude.execution) with a new migration and drop Event.Claude and the per-event token/cost fields and the run page's report section (recommended), or keep them read-only.

title: Drop the reporter (integrations/claude-code); telemetry is the only usage path
